_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is statistically dominant (0/61 windows with ±2+ moves) and no breaker is visible — ETF flow collapse and MVRV divergence cancel each other while VIX at 62 signals hedging not risk-seeking, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until either accumulation confirms or support breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward calls Disbelief/HOLD (neutral drift up the ladder) while narrative implies a potential bottoming squeeze (constructive); the split is real but the coil base rate overrides both directional leanings.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30, funding drops below 40, and BTC holds $62k — this would validate the accumulation thesis and justify upgrading toward LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay near 0 and BTC breaks below $60k with funding rising above 60 — this kills the bottoming narrative and confirms RISK_OFF
